theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → (∀ x ∈ M, tangentSpace M x ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P))) → IsOrientation m M ξ → ∃ ν₀ : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContinuousOn ν₀ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, ν₀ x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν₀ x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν₀ x) v = 0
